title: BLT byte embeddings never initialized to teacher-embedding stats — kept default kaiming
trigger_conditions: BLT distill training with target_embeddings provided
root_cause: fix_init computed te_mean and te_std of the target embeddings but used them only when initializing hash_embeddings; the main self.embedding.weight (byte embeddings) was never assigned the te-scaled init, leaving it at nn.Embedding's default initialization. The encoder therefore started training with byte embeddings whose distribution did not match the teacher's vocabulary embeddings.
invariant: When a teacher embedding source is provided, the byte embedding must be sampled from a distribution with the same per-channel mean/std as the teacher embeddings.
diff_summary: Sample byte_embedding_init from te_std * randn + te_mean and copy into self.embedding.weight.data after the hash-embedding init block.
silent_check: Buggy init runs without exception — self.embedding.weight retains its default initialization, training proceeds with a finite but mis-scaled byte embedding distribution that the user only catches via convergence-rate comparison.
